message.content:
A vertical magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black letters features an illustration of six figures in medical protective gear. The figures wear green or white gowns, masks, goggles, and hoods. One figure on the right wears a yellow face shield and white hood. Another figure in the center-right holds a black thermometer. Their gloved hands grip the edges of a light blue rectangular surface that angles downward toward the viewer. A thin grey pole stands behind the central figures, supporting a clear IV bag and coiled white tubing. 

The background is a solid light green. At the top, white text reads "STRATEGI ANTISIPASI KRISIS EKONOMI" and "TIGA CALON KETUA MAHKAMAH AGUNG" separated by a diagonal line. Centered over the blue surface is large white text: "DARURAT COVID-19". Smaller white text below details doctors and health workers. The bottom right displays a barcode, price "RP 45.000", and dates "23-29 MARET 2020". A QR code is in the bottom left corner. A thick red border lines the left edge.
